welcome.title: Welcome to the Isocode Workspace
welcome.subtitle: Before you start, here's how we handle your information.
points: We use what you submit here only to assess your application for the roles you were shortlisted for.
Your work is reviewed by the Isocode team. Some written answers may be summarised by an AI assistant to help reviewers; a person always makes the decision.
Timed assessments record when you leave full-screen or switch tabs, so reviewers have context.
We keep your data for 12 months after the hiring round closes, then delete it. You can ask us to delete it sooner by replying to any of our emails.
